title: Lenticular
description: A lenticular flip card from a 1960s record shop: ridged plastic over two prints of the same sleeve, the cover and a regraded, pushed-in version of it titled with its song, so tilting Abbey Road turns the crossing into a golden-hour Here Comes the Sun in the plastic. Tap the card and it flips over to the next record.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: the view angle through each ridge picks between two prints of one cover, so the change reads as depth in a single card, with the banding, fringing and sheen of a real flip card and a tap that turns it over to the next record.
